summary: A 41-ft timber L-4 lookout built in 1953 on Firefighter Mountain above Hungry Horse Reservoir, replacing a 1923 cabin site; still active and staffed in summer.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 41-ft timber tower (1953); hip roof later replaced by a flat roof

access.note: Reached by Forest Service road 38B. A gate on the road is open to vehicles after July 1. No source says whether the cab is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: About four miles up Forest Service road 38B to the lookout, described by one guide as a steady climb on a well-maintained road.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Flathead National Forest

Cupola added to the 1923 cabin the year after it was established
Bureau of Reclamation contract let for the replacement tower, house and 3.85-mile road
41-ft L-4 tower built about 1.5 miles northwest of the original cabin
Replaced the earlier log cabin cupola lookout
One known lookout listed on firelookout.com for 1957

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1923 is the first frame cabin on the site (firelookout.com). 1953 is the present 41-ft tower (NHLR, firelookout.com, and the August 1953 newspaper item). Both dates are accurate for different structures.

An April 1952 item names Columbia Falls Lumber Company for the tower. The July 11 and August 29, 1952 items and an August 21, 1953 report name Valley Construction. The record does not explain the change, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Build year 1953 is well corroborated across NHLR, firelookout.com and 1952-1953 newspaper items quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. Staffing is only described as summer and is undated. The Moss Mountain Inn guide is a lodging site's hiking article and its road-access and gate details are undated. No fire history or rental listing found. Verify current access and staffing with the Flathead National Forest. Brief record fields (design L-4, 1953 build, 2011 registration) are supported, so no corrections proposed.
